muse_spark_1.3/001: Strategy is deep alpha-beta negamax with iterative deepening, quiescence on forced captures, maximal-capture filtering and positional evaluation. Men move forward but capture in all 4 diagonals, kings move 1 step in all diagonals, promotion ends the turn. Search orders captures by length and victims, quiets by promotion and advancement, uses centralization, advancement, back-rank and material evaluation, and always falls back to a legal maximal capture.
muse_spark_1.3/002: Strategy is short-range alpha-beta with iterative deepening, quiescence on captures, and fast positional evaluation. Men move forward one diagonal, men capture in all four diagonals, kings move/capture one step in all four diagonals, promotion on last rank, mandatory captures. Search uses MVV-LVA + promotion + advancement ordering, white-relative material 100/140 plus advancement, centre, back-rank bonuses, win/loss on no-moves or no-pieces, stand-pat quiescence, 0.85s time control with timeout fallback to first capture.
muse_spark_1.3/003: Strategy is deep alpha-beta search for English draughts. Men move forward, men captures prioritized forward, kings one step diagonal, captures mandatory, promotion on last rank. Evaluation is material man 100 king 140 plus advancement, centre, back-rank and edge bonuses with king centralisation. Root uses iterative deepening with capture-first ordering, quiescence extension on captures, mate scores, time limit ~0.9s, multi-jump continuation detection via stored post-board, and guaranteed legal fallback.
muse_spark_1.3/004: The strategy is short-king English draughts with mandatory captures, fast alpha-beta negamax, iterative deepening under 0.85s, capture-first move ordering, quiescence on captures only and material plus piece-square evaluation.
muse_spark_1.3/005: The strategy is a fast alpha-beta search with quiescence and time control. Material is man=100 king=140, plus advancement, centre, edge and back-rank bonuses and king centralisation. All captures are generated first to respect mandatory captures, men quiet forward only, men captures forward preferred then backward, kings in all 4 diagonals one step. Moves are ordered by victim value, promotion and centralisation. Negamax with alpha-beta and capture extensions to depth -4 is used inside iterative deepening until ~0.9s, keeping the best move from the last completed depth. A fully legal fallback guarantees a capture if available.
